about: Backend doors whose image is PINNED instead of following the node's release. A door here is recreated (with its engine) only when its pin changes, never on a release roll alone. The controller stages each pin on the artifact rail (noo-cli image_stage.rs, source door-pin, never pruned by release retention); the node agent runs it (node-agent-go/internal/docker/door_images.json, byte-equal copy). To move a door: set image/tag/digest to a published release's stunnel row (stack-vX.Y.Z.lock `stunnel@sha256:...`).
